content: yfinance ticker convention: crypto pairs use a dash suffix (BTC-USD), forex pairs use an =X suffix (EURUSD=X), gold futures use =F (GC=F). At daily interval, crypto returns a row for every calendar day (7/week) while equities/ETFs and forex return rows only for trading days recognized by Yahoo's data (forex is not a strict 24/7 series in yfinance's daily bars despite the real market trading nearly continuously Sun-Fri) -- meaning naive concatenation/alignment across asset classes on a shared DatetimeIndex will show NaN gaps or misalignment for equities/forex on days crypto has data (weekends), and this must be handled generically in feature_frame.py via per-asset .dropna()/reindex rather than assuming one shared calendar.
